title: Argo Workflows / Operations
description: Curated health view of Argo Workflows in the homelab: controller and server up, workflows and their pods by phase, controller saturation (queues, workers, API), archive DB. Built from the Argo Workflows v4.1.6 metrics docs (https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md) and the argo-workflows-mixin (https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/tree/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152); mixin dashboard: 'Argo Workflows / Overview (mixin)'.

panels.title: How to read this dashboard
panels.description: Reading guide for this dashboard.

options.content:
**What Argo Workflows does here.** Argo Workflows v4.1.6 (chart 2.0.18, namespace `argo-workflows`): the
**workflow-controller** runs Workflows/CronWorkflows (pods in `argo-workflows`, ServiceAccount `argo-workflow`), the
**argo-server** serves the UI/API at https://argo-workflows.<domain> (Keycloak SSO). Finished workflows are archived
in the CloudNativePG cluster **workflows-db** (30 days) and leave the cluster after 7 days; logs and artifacts go to R2.
ClusterWorkflowTemplates `argocd-sync` and `github-watch`; Argo Events Sensors can submit workflows here.

**Scraped:** controller `/metrics` :9090 (OpenTelemetry → Prometheus names, counters without `_total`); workflows-db
(CNPG PodMonitor). **Not scraped:** argo-server (`/metrics` answers 403 without a token) — the server row uses
kube-state-metrics. Counters such as `argo_workflows_total_count`, `pods_total_count`, `cronworkflows_triggered_total`
only appear after the first workflow/CronWorkflow run handled by the current controller Pod, so those panels start empty.
The Workflow's own namespace is `exported_namespace` (the scrape sets `namespace`).

**Healthy looks like:** controller UP and leader, 0 controller errors, queues near 0, failed/error workflows explained.
**When something is red:** `kubectl --context k8s01 -n argo-workflows get wf` / `argo -n argo-workflows get <wf>`,
`kubectl --context k8s01 -n argo-workflows logs deploy/argo-workflows-workflow-controller` (json), the archive DB in
dashboard *PostgreSQL / Clusters*.

panels.title: Active alerts for this service
panels.description: Prometheus alerts of this service that are FIRING (condition true for longer than the rule's `for`) or PENDING (condition true, waiting for `for`). Same filter as the red alert annotations of this dashboard; Watchdog/InfoInhibitor are excluded. Empty = healthy. Alertmanager has no receiver in this lab, so dashboards are where alerts are seen: the rule, its threshold and source are in the rule files (helm-charts/<app>/**/prometheus.rules.yaml or the -raw release) and in docs/dashboards/. All alerts of the lab: dashboard "Alerts overview" (Observability folder).

panels.title: Controller
panels.description: Prometheus can scrape the workflow-controller (:9090). Down = no workflow advances. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md. Derived query: Prometheus `up` of the scrape job.

panels.title: Leader
panels.description: `argo_workflows_is_leader`: 1 = this controller runs workflows (always 1 with one replica). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: Version
panels.description: `argo_workflows_version` (must match the pin v4.1.6). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: Server pods ready
panels.description: Available replicas of Deployment argo-workflows-server (UI/API; not scraped by Prometheus). Source: https://github.com/kubernetes/kube-state-metrics/blob/main/docs/metrics/workload/deployment-metrics.md.

panels.title: Archive DB
panels.description: CloudNativePG exporter of workflows-db is up (`cnpg_collector_up`). Down = archiving fails. Source: https://cloudnative-pg.io/documentation/current/monitoring/.

panels.title: Running
panels.description: Workflows in phase Running (`argo_workflows_gauge`). Running does not mean pods run. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin "Active Workflows" (https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/tree/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152).

panels.title: Pending
panels.description: Workflows in phase Pending (alert `ArgoWorkflowsPendingWorkflows` above 5 for 15 min). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md, https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/tree/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152.

panels.title: Failed / Error in cluster
panels.description: Workflows still in the cluster in phase Failed or Error (kept 7 days by the TTL). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin "Unhealthy Workflows".

panels.title: Workflows in the cluster by phase
panels.description: `argo_workflows_gauge` by phase (Pending, Running, Succeeded, Failed, Error). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin "Current Workflows by Phase".

panels.title: Workflow phase changes
panels.description: Workflows entering each phase (`argo_workflows_total_count`, by workflow namespace). Failed/Error here drive `ArgoWorkflowsHighWorkflowFailureRate`. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin "Workflow Completions by Phase".

panels.title: Success rate (24h)
panels.description: Succeeded / (Succeeded + Failed + Error) over 24 h. Source: mixin "Success Rate" (https://github.com/adinhodovic/argo-workflows-mixin/tree/c331414c1bb3bf95f4f83c951cea298674290152).

panels.title: Completions (24h)
panels.description: Workflows that finished in 24 h by phase. Source: mixin "Workflow Completions by Phase".

panels.title: Template runs by phase
panels.description: Runs of WorkflowTemplates/ClusterWorkflowTemplates (via workflowTemplateRef) entering each phase (`argo_workflows_workflowtemplate_triggered_total`; cluster_scope=true for argocd-sync, github-watch). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: Template runtime (p95)
panels.description: Running → finished time of workflows using a template (`argo_workflows_workflowtemplate_runtime`). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; Grafana 21393 "Workflow Template Runtime".

panels.title: CronWorkflow triggers
panels.description: CronWorkflow runs started (`cronworkflows_triggered_total`) and runs suppressed by concurrencyPolicy (`cronworkflows_concurrencypolicy_triggered`). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin "CronWorkflow Triggers".

panels.title: Pods by phase
panels.description: Workflow pods in the cluster by phase (`argo_workflows_pods_gauge`). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin "Current Pods by Phase".

panels.title: Pods pending by reason
panels.description: Pods that started pending, by reason (`argo_workflows_pod_pending_count`; e.g. Unschedulable, PodInitializing excluded). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin "Pending Pods by Reason".

panels.title: Missing / restarted pods
panels.description: Pods the controller expected but did not see (`argo_workflows_pod_missing`) and pods restarted after an infrastructure failure (`argo_workflows_pod_restarts_total`). Both should stay at 0. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin.

panels.title: Controller errors by cause
panels.description: `argo_workflows_error_count` by cause: OperationPanic (bug), CronWorkflowSubmissionError (a scheduled run was not created), CronWorkflowSpecError. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin "Controller Errors by Cause".

panels.title: Log messages by level
panels.description: Controller log lines per second by level (`argo_workflows_log_messages`); a rise of error/warning is an early signal. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin "Log Messages by Level".

panels.title: Operation duration
panels.description: Time to reconcile one workflow (`argo_workflows_operation_duration_seconds`), p50/p95. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin "Workflow Operation Duration".

panels.title: Queue depth
panels.description: Items waiting per queue (workflow, cron_wf, pod_cleanup, workflow_ttl, workflow_archive). Large = controller not keeping up (alert `ArgoWorkflowsQueueDepthHigh` above 100). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin.

panels.title: Queue latency (p95)
panels.description: Time items wait before processing (`argo_workflows_queue_latency`, the documented latency golden signal). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin "Queue Latency".

panels.title: Busy workers
panels.description: Workers busy per queue (`argo_workflows_workers_busy_count`; saturation golden signal). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: Kubernetes API requests by code
panels.description: Requests to the API server by kind/verb/status (`argo_workflows_k8s_request_total`). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin "K8s API Request Rate by Status Code".

panels.title: Kubernetes API latency (p95)
panels.description: 95th percentile per verb (`argo_workflows_k8s_request_duration`). Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md; mixin.

panels.title: Client rate limiter wait (p95)
panels.description: Time spent blocked by the client-go rate limiter (QPS/Burst) before API calls (`argo_workflows_client_rate_limiter_latency`). Rising = raise the controller QPS. Source: https://github.com/argoproj/argo-workflows/blob/v4.1.6/docs/metrics.md.

panels.title: Archive DB operations
panels.description: SQL operations of the controller on workflows-db per second (`argo_workflows_db_client_operation_duration` count, OpenTelemetry database semantic conventions; not in the v4.1.6 metrics list but exported by the controller). Source: https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/database/database-metrics/.

panels.title: Archive DB operation latency (avg)
panels.description: Average SQL operation time (sum / count of the same histogram). Source: https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/database/database-metrics/. Derived query: average from _sum/_count.

panels.title: Memory working set vs limit
panels.description: Memory per Argo Workflows (controller, server, workflow pods, workflows-db) container (solid) and its limit (dashed). Source: https://github.com/kubernetes-monitoring/kubernetes-mixin.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: CPU cores used per Argo Workflows (controller, server, workflow pods, workflows-db) container. Source: https://github.com/kubernetes-monitoring/kubernetes-mixin.
